description: The agent must: (1) Parse payslips_2025.csv — deduplicate the duplicate June row and include the '2025-13M' (13th month) row — giving employment gross €41,600; subtract social security (12×€384=€4,608) for employment net €36,992. (2) Parse consulting_invoices_2025.json — exclude the DRAFT invoice (INV-2025-004-DRAFT) — summing confirmed invoices to €14,000 gross; compute 20% withholding = €2,800; sum business expenses (800+700+1200+800=€3,500) for consulting net €10,500. (3) Parse rental_income_2025.tsv — gross €9,000, expenses €600 → rental net €8,400; apply the RENTAL-SPECIFIC tax schedule (15% on first €12,000) = €1,260 — NOT the progressive income tax brackets. (4) Parse receipts_summary_2025.txt — extract insurance (€2,000), charity (€1,500), medical (€2,200); apply: insurance cap = min(2000, 1200×4 family members) = €2,000; charity cap = min(1500, max(55892×5%, 2000)) = €1,500 (full amount); medical = €2,200 (no limit); total deductions = €5,700. (5) Compute taxable income for progressive tax = (36992 + 10500) - 5700 = €41,792. (6) Apply 5-bracket progressive tax: €10,288.48. (7) Apply solidarity tax (starts above €30,000): €309.60. (8) Apply family credits: €2,100 (basic) + €2,100 (spouse with zero income) + 2×€777 (children) = €6,054. (9) Net main tax after credits = 10598.08 - 6054 = €4,544.08. (10) Total withholding = €6,100 (employer certificate value) + €2,800 (consulting) = €8,900. (11) Net final = (4544.08 + 1260 rental tax) - 8900 = -€3,095.92 → refund of €3,095.92, net_tax_due = 0. Output e1_summary_2025.json with all these fields.
